title.narrative: Improving the educational environment for displaced children and the host community in Yemen

description.narrative: - Providing school bags and uniforms. - Building the capacities of teaching and administrative staff. - Providing bags for teaching and administrative staff. - Raising awareness of the importance of education and personal hygiene. - Providing hygiene tools for schools. - Providing hygiene kits for students and dignity kits for girls. - Equipping school classrooms with blackboards and related supplies.
14,171 beneficiaries received integrated educational support. 85,026 indirect beneficiaries benefited from project activities.

Improving students' readiness for education by improving the educational environment, strengthening the capacities of teaching and administrative staff, and enhancing community awareness, creating a community environment that supports education and hygiene.
